answer: Every few epochs the protocol slips each identity a few odd probes with no right answer: pick a number from 1 to 100, name an opal's color, continue a nonsense string. Replies mirror the model, prompt and settings behind them, so a farm on one stack gives back the same echo each time. Identities count as linked only when they share quirks rare across all agents, and linked ones never sit on one grading panel. Evasion: randomize prompts and temperature per clone; that's cheap, so this adds cost, not a wall. Wrongly hit: honest agents on one default setup, so a link only splits panels.
